name: Elentix Addons for Elementor — Widgets, Extensions & Effects
author: RSTheme

sections.description:
Elentix Addons for Elementor supercharges the Elementor page builder with a growing library of modern widgets, smart extensions and ready-to-use custom post types — without the bloat.

Every widget loads only the CSS and JavaScript it actually needs, so your pages stay lean and fast. A clean, namespaced codebase and a built-in React dashboard let you switch each element on or off, so you ship exactly the features you want and nothing more.

Whether you are building a business site, a portfolio, or a full agency landing page, Elentix gives you the building blocks to design faster and look better.

Why you’ll love Elentix

  • ⚡ Performance first — per-widget asset loading. Assets are registered and enqueued only when a widget is on the page.
  • 🎛️ Full control — enable or disable any widget, extension or post type from the admin dashboard.
  • 🔎 Element usage scanner — see what’s actually used across your site before you turn things off.
  • 🧱 20+ free widgets covering content, media, forms, blog and more.
  • 🎨 Powerful free extensions that add new superpowers to your existing Elementor elements.
  • 🗂️ Built-in custom post types for Portfolio, Services and Team.
  • 🌍 Translation ready and developer friendly (namespaced, modular, OOP).
  • ✅ Safe by design — strict Elementor & PHP compatibility checks with graceful admin notices.

⚠️ This plugin requires Elementor to be installed and activated.

🚀 Free Widgets

Content & Layout

  • Heading: Grab attention instantly. Craft bold, multi-style headings with highlighted words, gradients and perfect spacing.
  • Button: Turn clicks into conversions with fully customizable buttons — icons, hover animations, gradients and more.
  • Icon Box: Explain your features and services at a glance with icon, title and text combined in one striking block.
  • Icon List: Present benefits, checklists and specs as clean, icon-led lists that are easy to scan.
  • Social Icons: Grow your audience by linking every social profile in a sleek, hover-animated icon row.
  • Price Card: Sell smarter with pricing tables that highlight your best plan and guide buyers to “Buy now”.
  • Business Hours: Tell visitors exactly when you’re open with a clear, elegant opening-hours table.
  • Content Reveal: Keep pages tidy by hiding long content behind a smooth “read more” reveal.
  • Content Ticker: Put your latest news, offers or announcements in motion with an eye-catching scrolling ticker.

Media & Showcase

  • Testimonial: Build instant trust by showcasing customer reviews as beautiful cards or sliders.
  • Team Members: Put a face to your business with polished profile cards, roles and social links.
  • Logo Showcase: Prove your credibility by displaying client, partner or brand logos in a tidy grid or slider.
  • Portfolio: Show off your best work in a filterable gallery, powered by the built-in Portfolio post type.
  • Video Popup: Boost engagement with a lightweight click-to-play video lightbox that never slows your page.

Data & Interaction

  • Progress Bar: Visualize skills, stats and completion with smooth animated progress bars.
  • Counter: Impress visitors with animated number counters for stats, milestones and achievements.
  • Bar Chart: Turn dry numbers into clear, animated bar charts your visitors actually understand.
  • Accordion: Answer FAQs and organize long content into tidy, tap-to-expand sections.

Blog & Forms

  • Blog Post Grid: Keep your site fresh by displaying your latest posts in a modern, responsive grid.
  • Contact Form 7: Make your existing CF7 forms gorgeous — style every field, label and button right inside Elementor.

Each widget loads only its own CSS/JS, so you add features without slowing your site down.

🔧 Free Extensions

Extensions supercharge the elements you already use — no new widget required:

  • Link Anything: Make an entire section, container or column clickable, so visitors can tap anywhere to go.
  • Accordion Extender: Unlock extra design and behavior controls for Elementor’s native accordion.
  • Container Style Extender: Push containers further with advanced styling controls Elementor doesn’t offer out of the box.
  • AOS Animation: Bring pages to life by animating any element as it scrolls into view.
  • Pseudo Style: Add decorative ::before / ::after layers to any widget and style them fully — no code needed.
  • Motion Keyframe: Design your own custom keyframe animations visually and apply them to any element.
  • Custom CSS: Fine-tune any element with your own CSS, right where you’re editing it.

🗂️ Custom Post Types

Ready-to-use, dashboard-toggleable content types:

  • Portfolio
  • Services
  • Team

🧩 Smart Asset Management

  • Sliders powered by Swiper
  • Scroll animations powered by AOS
  • Counters powered by Odometer
  • Charts powered by Chart.js
  • Element usage scanner + on/off switch in the dashboard
  • Assets registered and loaded only when required

⚙️ Built With Developers in Mind

  • Fully namespaced codebase (ElentixAddons\)
  • Config-driven, modular widget & extension system
  • Elementor version & PHP version compatibility checks
  • Clean activation, versioning and translation (.pot) support

⭐ Go Pro — Elentix Addons for Elementor Pro

Unlock advanced widgets and jaw-dropping GSAP-powered effects with Elentix Addons for Elementor Pro:

Pro Widgets

  • Flip Box: Reveal a surprise on hover or click with interactive 3D flip cards that make content memorable.
  • Advance Search: Help visitors find anything instantly with lightning-fast AJAX search across your post types.
  • Nested Slider: Build unlimited slides that hold full Elementor layouts — design each slide with zero limits.
  • Marquee Slider: Turn any slider into a smooth, continuous auto-scrolling marquee that grabs the eye.
  • Advanced Tab: Organize rich content into stunning, fully-styled tabs with layouts Elementor can’t match.
  • Creative Iconic Card: Make features pop with bold, animated icon cards designed to stop the scroll.

Pro Extensions & Effects

  • Particles Animation: Add mesmerizing, interactive particle backgrounds to any section (Particles.js).
  • Image Distortion: Wow visitors with fluid WebGL image-distortion effects on hover (Flowmap).
  • Parallax Effect: Add depth and motion with buttery-smooth scroll parallax (Jarallax).
  • Text Animation: Reveal headlines word-by-word with cinematic GSAP split-text and color-fill effects.
  • Sticky / Pin Element: Keep key elements pinned in view as the page scrolls for high-impact storytelling (GSAP).
  • Horizontal Scroll: Break the grid with immersive horizontal-scrolling sections (GSAP).
  • Scroll / Magnet Effect: Add playful, magnetic motion that reacts to the cursor and scroll (GSAP).

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later
  • Elementor 3.30 or later

If requirements are not met, the plugin displays admin notices and safely disables itself.

Credits

  • Elementor — Page Builder
  • Swiper.js
  • AOS (Animate On Scroll)
  • Odometer
  • jQuery Appear
  • Chart.js

sections.installation:
1. Upload the elentix-addons-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Open the Elementor editor and find the Elentix Addons widgets in the panel.
  5. (Optional) Go to the Elentix dashboard to enable/disable widgets, extensions and post types.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without Elementor?

No. Elementor must be installed and activated for Elentix Addons to work.

Will it slow down my website?

No. Each widget and extension loads its assets only when they are actually used on a page.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. This version includes 20+ widgets, 7 extensions and 3 custom post types for free. A Pro version adds advanced widgets and GSAP-powered effects.

Can I disable widgets or extensions I don’t use?

Yes. The built-in dashboard lets you toggle any widget, extension or post type on or off, and includes an element usage scanner.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. The plugin ships with a .pot file and is fully translatable.

What do I get with Pro?

Pro adds widgets like Flip Box, Advance Search, Nested Slider, Marquee Slider, Advanced Tab and Creative Iconic Card, plus premium effects such as Particles, Image Distortion, Parallax, Text Animation, Sticky/Pin, Horizontal Scroll and Magnet effects.
